meta.title: Frontier-wide S5 D4 stabilizer census + ranking bookkeeping audit (174 remaining S5)
meta.implementation: independent third implementation (TypeScript sandbox): D4 (order 8) canonical form and stabilizer computation written from scratch

controls.note: all 174 S5 hexes are fixed points of the third implementation's D4-canonical form and pairwise distinct - the ranking's canonical convention matches the independent implementation exactly

nontrivial_detail.note: Klein four-group (order 4) - largest stabilizer among all remaining S5; this is S5 'Q' on the engine task list (class-1)

stabilizer_census.stabilizer_vs_dup_correlation: measured same-session: order-2 stabilizer families showed 12.18% and 19.86% family-internal candidate-orbit duplication; trivial-stabilizer families showed 1.44% and 2.75% - stabilizer order is the leading structural predictor of family-internal redundancy

bookkeeping_consistency.observation: the ranking aggregates per-S5 families with multiplicity (a shared S6 child is counted once per parent family); 6429/12284 = 0.5232 and 508474/971026 = 0.5236 - consistent with multiplicity dedup at the S6 level, though this is a consistency indication, not an independent verification of 508474 (child-level lists would be needed)

recommendation.q_sweep: when the engine sweep for Q (00000000000000821082000000000000, class-1, 18 children / cost 1238) runs, apply family-level orbit dedup first: its order-4 stabilizer gives it the highest expected family-internal duplication of all remaining S5s (above the 19.86% measured for the order-2 class4 family)
recommendation.fleet_note: only 8/174 remaining S5s have nontrivial stabilizers; family-internal orbit transfer pays off mainly for these (1.8% of ranked cost). Cross-family orbit collisions (the 8.95% re-search redundancy measured in the 65f/65j census) require the global seen-orbit table instead

interpretation_guard.no_verdict_claim: this census contains no win/loss verdicts and changes the status of no root
interpretation_guard.stabilizer_meaning: stabilizer order predicts search-work redundancy only
interpretation_guard.solved_1419_note: solved 1419 counts are manifest coverage bookkeeping, not game outcomes
